scenario.title: The evidence pack an auditor extracts
scenario.summary: One payment from capture to settlement, then the complete trail for it and for the batch that carried it, extracted through GET /audit/evidence/{subjectId}.

releaseAudit.label: COMPLETE
releaseAudit.statement: RELEASE AUDIT: COMPLETE. Charter items 1-8 of 8 were performed (migrations replayed from empty; the full suite; cross-document consistency; the partial-set sweep; standing-lessons compliance; known-debt reconciliation; the synthetic-data and neutrality sweep; citation discipline over 230 citations). Four sessions on the CodeSpace path: A-C on GPT-5.6 Sol, D - citation verification and the report - on a model the session could not name. Nothing was skipped and no fallback was needed. Deliverable: docs/audits/FEEDBACK-REL-ref-2.md.

scopeStatement.disclaimer: CloFin operates on synthetic data only. It is not connected to any bank, payment scheme or central bank, holds no regulatory authorisation, and never processes real funds.

amounts.note: Money crosses the API as an integer count of minor units. Every `display` string in this bundle was produced from the adjacent minorUnits by the system's own formatter, in clofin-core, at capture time — never in a browser.

steps.title: What you are about to watch
steps.narrative: A single payment is raised, submitted, approved, released in a batch and settled. Then the evidence pack for it is extracted, and the pack for the batch that carried it.

steps.title: An organisation to act in
steps.narrative: A third organisation, for the evidence-pack scenario.

steps.title: Seed a maker, a checker and a controller
steps.narrative: Three actors, one role each: the maker holds `operator`, the checker `approver` with an SGD limit, and the controller `controller`; and one SGD approval band.

steps.title: Seed an auditor
steps.narrative: Rae reads the trail and nothing else.

steps.title: Open 1100-CLIENT-FUNDS
steps.narrative: Settlement touches three accounts; this is 1100-CLIENT-FUNDS.

steps.title: Open 1300-IN-TRANSIT
steps.narrative: Settlement touches three accounts; this is 1300-IN-TRANSIT.

steps.title: Open 2100-CLIENT-PAYABLE
steps.narrative: Settlement touches three accounts; this is 2100-CLIENT-PAYABLE.

steps.title: The chart of accounts
steps.narrative: Which way each account normally balances is not a stored column — it follows from the account's type — so it is read here, from the API, rather than looked up later.

steps.title: The client's money arrives
steps.narrative: So the payment has something to move.

steps.title: Raise a payment ending 0
steps.narrative: One payment, raised by the maker.

steps.title: Submit the payment ending 0
steps.narrative: The maker submits their own draft.

steps.title: Approve the payment ending 0
steps.narrative: A different actor, holding `approver`, agrees it.

steps.title: Release it
steps.narrative: The instruction becomes `released` and the value posts to in-transit.

steps.title: The scheme settles it
steps.narrative: Every item is resolved, so the batch completes.

steps.title: The evidence pack for the payment
steps.narrative: Six events, in order: created, submitted, the approval decision, the payment reaching approved, released, settled. `approval.recorded` and `payment.approved` are separate because they are separate facts — one actor decided, and the payment changed state.

steps.title: The evidence pack for the batch
steps.narrative: The batch's own subject type, and exactly one `settlement-batch.completed` — written when the last item resolved, not once per response.

steps.title: The whole trail for the organisation
steps.narrative: Capped rather than paginated, with the cap and a `truncated` flag on every response.
